Task instruction: Use the left arm to click the blue alarm clock's top center button.

Task description: Use the left arm to press the center button on top of the blue alarm clock.

Success criteria: Use the closed left gripper to make actual contact with the small area near the center button on top of the blue alarm clock, at a height close to the button. Merely hovering above it does not count.

## Execution tips

- If the button is obscured or hard to see, adjust the viewing angle and identify the central button relative to the alarm clock's own top surface. Do not use the center of the clock body in the image as the click target.
- Close the left gripper in open space above the bell body, then lower the closed fingertips toward the button in small steps to avoid open fingers spanning past it and touching other parts first.
